I was greeted respectfully by the reception. I was updated that the doctor was running slightly behind. Which is appreciated.

After a short wait I was seen by Dr AKHTAR (female) She was very professional, respectful, understanding, compassionate and helpful.

She provided a plan for treatment in a very clear and structured way.

She provided long term advice.

She took into account my situation and escalated the investigation into my issue as urgent.

Thank you Dr Akhtar 👍

A complete and comprehensive experience with no complaints... 5 STARS.

The environment of the practice is clean and friendly.

PLEASE always remain positive and optimistic, mistakes happen by all of us always look for the good in people and overlook thier mistakes.

The NHS has a difficult task by working together we can make a more productive and helpful experience.
